text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates bus service on Overlea Boulevard, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install traffic control signals at the intersection of Overlea Boulevard and Leaside Park Drive. The installation of traffic control signals is technically justified and will enhance safety for all road users. However, this installation may increase delays for motorists on Overlea Boulevard, as these movements will no longer operate with free flow. Additionally, there are civil modifications required to the centre median on Overlea Boulevard as part of this signal installation, which will increase the costs and delay the installation.

City Council on June 26, 27, 28 and 29, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of Overlea Boulevard and Leaside Park Drive.
